services.name: Past Tours
services.desc: The Toe River Arts Studio Tour - scheduled for November 14-16, 2025 - will open the studios and galleries of more than 80 artists across rural Mitchell County and Yancey County in the mountains of western North Carolina. Visitors will be able to drive a self-guided route through the scenic countryside, meet the artists in their working spaces, and explore diverse media and gallery sites scattered throughout the two counties. The event is an enriching mix of art, craft, and Appalachian charm - perfect for a weekend of discovery, inspiration, and regional culture.
